name: Bigaku Yurika & Asuna
source:
There is a prestige school where rich and high-class students enter and Asuna, an ordinary and innocent girl, and Yurika, a super rich student, meet there. Their encounter  creates a vortex of dark desires in the school and spreads a gruesome world of madness involving other students....

[Edited from ErogeShop]
